description: This file contains native Win32 interop methods and structures used internally by PDFsharp for GDI-related operations, including font and device context management.

classes.name: NativeMethods
classes.description: Static class providing P/Invoke signatures for Win32 GDI and User32 functions, used for font and device context operations.

classes.name: LOGFONT
classes.description: Represents the LOGFONT structure used in font creation and manipulation in Win32 API.

methods.name: GetDC
methods.description: Retrieves a handle to a device context (DC) for the client area of a specified window or for the entire screen.

methods.name: ReleaseDC
methods.description: Releases a device context (DC), freeing it for use by other GDI functions.

methods.name: GetFontData
methods.description: Retrieves font metric data for a specified font from a device context.

methods.name: CreateDC
methods.description: Creates a device context for a specified device, driver, and port.

methods.name: CreateCompatibleDC
methods.description: Creates a memory device context compatible with the specified device.

methods.name: CreateFontIndirect
methods.description: Creates a logical font that has the characteristics specified in the LOGFONT structure.

methods.name: SelectObject
methods.description: Selects an object into the specified device context (DC).

methods.name: DeleteObject
methods.description: Deletes a GDI object, freeing its resources.

methods.name: GetDeviceCaps
methods.description: Retrieves device-specific information for the specified device context.
